## History

Minnie May suffered a severe case of croup when she was three years old, leaving her feverish and breathing hoarsely. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) was away in town, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) sought help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treated Minnie May through the night using her past experience before the doctor arrived. She also once cried after someone told her that she was ugly.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

When Minnie May fell severely ill with croup while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) was away, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushed to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to seek help, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to treat Minnie May through the night using her past experience caring for twins. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully kept her safe until the doctor arrived the following morning. This act of saving Minnie May's life prompted Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her to resume her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), +1 more_

- Saved by  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>
